Verify the results list (id 'results') contains a list item with class 'result-item' and attribute data-doc-id="w3" whose text contains 'finissons'.     ## Result Format
    ``````markdown
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
